clips.title: The story
paras: Beldin Steelgrill is a renowned dwarven engineer and the master technician operating Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Widely regarded as one of the finest siege engine mechanics in Khaz Modan, he oversees the maintenance of the Ironforge military's heavy armor and treaded warmachines. Keeping those massive contraptions running requires an endless supply of high-grade specialized tools.

Situated just down the road from Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot serves as the primary proving ground and service station for dwarven steam tanks and siege engines. Beldin Steelgrill stands as its chief technician, celebrated far and wide for his unmatched expertise in repairing and tuning armored war wagons. Taming heavy metal and rumbling boilers is unforgiving work, and Beldin burns through gear rapidly. His constant demand for heavy wrenches, cutters, and precision instruments frequently pushes local ironworkers to their limits just to keep his workbench supplied.
